```tsx
import { Link } from 'expo-router'
import { Pressable, View } from 'react-native'

import { Button } from '../design-system/Button'
import { Chip } from '../design-system/Chip'
import { Glyph } from '../design-system/Glyph'
import { Tag } from '../design-system/Tag'
import { Text } from '../design-system/Text'
import type { projectHeaderOf } from './model'
import { styles, tabFrame } from './ProjectHeader.styles'

// Glyph and color of the declared health level (wireframe.css:117).
const RAG = {
  green: { glyph: 'ragGreen', tone: 'good' },
  amber: { glyph: 'ragAmber', tone: 'waiting' },
  red: { glyph: 'ragRed', tone: 'critical' }
} as const

// Project header (spec 4.1, wireframes/assets/shell.js:118-134). Screen 24 renders it at the top of the screen, because the data
// of the header lives in the contract of the overview screen (spec 3.5).
export function ProjectHeader({ header }: { header: ReturnType<typeof projectHeaderOf> }) {
  const rag = RAG[header.health.level]
  return (
    <View testID="project-header" style={styles.frame}>
      <View style={styles.top}>
        <View style={styles.titleBlock}>
          <Text variant="projectTitle" heading={1}>
            {header.title}
          </Text>
          <View style={styles.meta}>
            <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
              {header.client}
            </Text>
            <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
              {header.dot}
            </Text>
            <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
              {header.pm}
            </Text>
            <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
              {header.dot}
            </Text>
            <Chip tone="running">{header.stage}</Chip>
            <View style={styles.health}>
              <Glyph name={rag.glyph} size="badge" tone={rag.tone} label={header.health.text} />
              <Text variant="small" weight="500" tone="muted">
                {header.health.text}
              </Text>
            </View>
            <Tag variant="meta">{header.framework}</Tag>
            <Tag variant="meta">{header.baseline}</Tag>
          </View>
        </View>
        <View style={styles.actions}>
          <View testID="header-share" style={styles.share}>
            <Text variant="control">{header.share.label}</Text>
            <Tag variant="label">{header.share.note}</Tag>
          </View>
          <Button
            variant="primary"
            label={header.changeRequest.label}
            href={header.changeRequest.route}
            testID="header-change-request"
          />
        </View>
      </View>
      <View role="navigation" aria-label={header.tabsLabel} style={styles.tabs}>
        {header.tabs.map((tab) => (
          <Link key={tab.key} href={tab.route} asChild>
            <Pressable
              role="link"
              aria-current={tab.active ? 'page' : undefined}
              testID={tab.testID}
              style={tabFrame(tab.active)}
            >
              <Text variant="tab" tone={tab.active ? 'text' : 'muted'}>
                {tab.label}
              </Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ))}
        <View style={styles.saved}>
          <Glyph name="saved" size="caption" tone="good" />
          <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
            {header.saved}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}
```

```ts
import { StyleSheet, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native'

import { tokens } from '../design-system/tokens'

// Project header (wireframe.css:48-56): the row of title and actions, then the row of tabs with the saved state.
export const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  frame: {
    paddingTop: tokens.space18,
    paddingHorizontal: tokens.pagePad,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
    borderBottomColor: tokens.line
  },
  top: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: tokens.space16 },
  titleBlock: { flex: 1 },
  meta: {
    marginTop: tokens.space6,
    flexDirection: 'row',
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: tokens.space10
  },
  health: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space5 },
  actions: { marginLeft: 'auto', flexDirection: 'row', gap: tokens.space8 },
  share: { flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space5 },
  tabs: { marginTop: tokens.gap, flexDirection: 'row', gap: tokens.space2 },
  tab: {
    paddingVertical: tokens.space9,
    paddingHorizontal: tokens.gap,
    borderBottomWidth: tokens.tabBorder,
    borderBottomColor: 'transparent'
  },
  tabActive: { borderBottomColor: tokens.ink },
  saved: {
    marginLeft: 'auto',
    alignSelf: 'center',
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: tokens.space6
  }
})

// A Pressable inside a Link asChild must have its style as an object, not an array (the Slot of expo-router
// merges the style of the Link into it), so the parts are flattened into one object.
export const tabFrame = (active: boolean) =>
  StyleSheet.flatten<ViewStyle>([styles.tab, active && styles.tabActive])
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'
import { renderRouter } from 'expo-router/testing-library'

import { tokens } from '../design-system/tokens'
import { meridian } from '../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { showroom } from '../mocks/fixtures/showroom'
import { projectHeaderOf } from './model'
import { ProjectHeader } from './ProjectHeader'
import { STRINGS } from './strings'

// The glyphs of Glyph are hidden from screen readers (aria-hidden), so the text lookup must reach them.
const HIDDEN = { includeHiddenElements: true }

// Build the header inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs when the file loads is a static mutant of
// Stryker).
const headerOf = (
  project: Parameters<typeof projectHeaderOf>[0] = meridian.project,
  context: Partial<Parameters<typeof projectHeaderOf>[1]> = {}
) =>
  projectHeaderOf(project, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh',
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    ...context
  })

const mount = (header = headerOf()) =>
  renderRouter({
    index: () => <ProjectHeader header={header} />,
    'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/wbs': () => null,
    'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/changes/new': () => null
  })

// renderRouter turns on the fake timers of Jest and never turns them off; under Stryker the automatic cleanup of RNTL hangs
// for the full 5 seconds (see Button.test.native.tsx). The afterEach of the nested block runs before the afterEach of the
// outer block, so the real timers are restored before that cleanup.
describe('ProjectHeader', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.useRealTimers()
  })

  test('frame: top padding space18, horizontal padding pagePad, bottom border line', async () => {
    await mount()

    expect(screen.getByTestId('project-header')).toHaveStyle({

      borderBottomColor: tokens.line

    expect(title.parent).toHaveStyle({ flex: 1 })
    expect(title.parent?.parent).toHaveStyle({
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'flex-start',
      gap: tokens.space16
    })
  })

  test('meta line in order: client, dot, PM, dot, stage, health, framework, baseline', async () => {
    await mount()

    expect(screen.getByText('Northwind Furniture Co.')).toHaveStyle({
      fontSize: tokens.fsSmall,

    })

    expect(screen.getByText('Creative Production v1.2')).toBeOnTheScreen()

    const meta = screen.getByText('PM Nadia R.').parent

      flexWrap: 'wrap',
      alignItems: 'center',

    })
    expect(meta).toHaveTextContent(
      'Northwind Furniture Co.·PM Nadia R.·Production · stage 3 of 6▲At riskCreative Production v1.2Baseline v1 · 25 Jun 2026'
    )
  })

  test('declared health level: glyph with a name and the color of the level, medium-weight gray text', async () => {
    await mount()

    const mark = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'At risk' })
    expect(mark).toHaveTextContent('▲')
    expect(mark).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.waiting, fontSize: tokens.fsBadge })

    })

      alignItems: 'center',

    })

  test.each([

  ] as const)('declared level %s: glyph %s and the color of the level', async (level, text, glyph, color) => {
    const project = { ...meridian.project, declaredHealth: level }
    await mount(headerOf(project))

    const mark = screen.getByRole('img', { name: text })

  test('Share is text with a Not built yet label, not a link', async () => {

    expect(share).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space5 })
    expect(within(share).getByText('Share')).toHaveStyle({ fontFamily: 'Manrope' })
    expect(within(share).getByText('Not built yet')).toBeOnTheScreen()
    expect(share.props.role).toBeUndefined()
    expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Share/ })).toBeNull()

  test('Raise change request is the primary button, pressing it opens the screen that creates a change request of the project', async () => {

  test('header text follows the language of the model: Vietnamese', async () => {
```

`src/shell/NotBuilt.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useLocalSearchParams, usePathname } from 'expo-router'
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { formatInteger } from '../core/format'
import { interpolate } from '../core/i18n/dictionary'
import { type Destination, filtersOf, SCREENS } from '../core/routes'
import { Text } from '../design-system/Text'
import { useLocale } from './locale'
import { styles } from './NotBuilt.styles'
import { STRINGS } from './strings'

// The generic "not built" page (spec 4.3 rule 1, R-B7): the title is the label of the destination, with the screen number, the path
// and the filters received. destination null is a path that is not in the route table: the "not
// found" page, with no screen number and no filters. The main region of the page is set by the shell (Shell.tsx), so this View
// has no role main: adding one would give the page two main regions.
export function NotBuilt({ destination }: { destination: Destination | null }) {
  const { locale } = useLocale()
  const strings = STRINGS[locale]
  const page = strings.page
  const pathname = usePathname()
  const params = useLocalSearchParams()
  const filters = destination === null ? [] : filtersOf(destination, params)
  return (
    <View testID={`not-built-${destination ?? 'unknown'}`} style={styles.page}>
      <Text variant="projectTitle" heading={1}>
        {destination === null ? page.notFound : strings.destinations[destination]}
      </Text>
      <Text variant="body">{destination === null ? page.notFoundBody : page.notBuilt}</Text>
      {destination === null ? null : (
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
          {interpolate(page.screen, { number: formatInteger(locale, SCREENS[destination]) })}
        </Text>
      )}
      <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
        {page.path}
      </Text>
      <Text variant="body">{pathname}</Text>
      <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
        {page.filters}
      </Text>
      {filters.length === 0 ? (
        <Text variant="body">{page.none}</Text>
      ) : (
        filters.map(([name, values]) => (
          <Text key={name} variant="body">
            {`${name}: ${values.join(', ')}`}
          </Text>
        ))
      )}
    </View>
  )
}
```

This version differs from the first draft (final fix wave): `NotBuilt` no longer has `role="main"`, the comment at the top of the function gives
the reason. The main region of every page is the `ScrollView` of `Shell` (Step 8), so if `NotBuilt` added one more
the page would have two main regions. Step 7 above was fixed to match; the first submission of Task 11, made following the template frame
of Task 8, still carried `role="main"`.

`src/shell/Shell.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useGlobalSearchParams, usePathname } from 'expo-router'
import type { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { ScrollView, View } from 'react-native'

import type { Shell as ShellData } from '../core/api/shell'
import { formatInteger } from '../core/format'
import type { Locale } from '../core/i18n/locale'
import { HOME } from '../platform/config'
import { useLocale } from './locale'
import { activeOf, crumbsOf, sidebarOf } from './model'
import { styles } from './Shell.styles'
import { Sidebar } from './Sidebar'
import { STRINGS } from './strings'
import { TopBar } from './TopBar'
import { useShell } from './useShell'

// The part of the top bar taken from the shell data; with no data yet the breadcrumb is empty, no
// user and no notification count.
function topBarDataOf(data: ShellData | null, locale: Locale, projectId: string | null) {
  if (data === null) return { crumbs: [], user: null, notifications: null }
  return {
    crumbs: crumbsOf(data, projectId),
    user: data.user,
    notifications: formatInteger(locale, data.notifications)
  }
}

// The shell of every page (spec 4.1): the sidebar and the top bar stay in place, the page scrolls inside a ScrollView
// (D-B22). The workspace comes from the path; a page that belongs to no workspace (/me/..., /search) takes the shell
// of the workspace in HOME (D-B23). The ScrollView of the page is the only main region of every page (child
// pages add none), so screen readers always have exactly one main region to jump to.
export function Shell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { workspaceId = HOME.workspaceId, projectId = null } = useGlobalSearchParams<{
    workspaceId?: string
    projectId?: string
  }>()
  const active = activeOf(usePathname())
  const shell = useShell(workspaceId)
  const { locale, setLocale } = useLocale()
  const strings = STRINGS[locale]
  const data = shell?.ok ? shell.data : null
  const bar = topBarDataOf(data, locale, projectId)
  return (
    <View testID="shell" style={styles.shell}>
      <Sidebar
        model={data && sidebarOf(data, { locale, strings, projectId, active })}
        brand={strings.brand}
        label={strings.sidebar.label}
        error={shell?.ok === false ? strings.sidebar.menuError : null}
      />
      <View style={styles.main}>
        <TopBar
          crumbs={bar.crumbs}
          strings={strings}
          user={bar.user}
          notifications={bar.notifications}
          workspaceId={workspaceId}
          locale={locale}
          onLocale={setLocale}
        />
        <ScrollView testID="page" role="main" style={styles.page}>
          {children}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}
```

This version differs from the first draft (final fix wave): the `ScrollView` `testID="page"` gains `role="main"`, the comment
at the top of the function says why. Before that the overview screen had no main region at all: axe reported `landmark-one-main` on 1 node
and `region` on 12 nodes (both at the moderate level); after the fix it is 0 and 0. Every page sits inside this `ScrollView`
(screen 24, the not-built page, the error page), so each page has exactly one main region; measured on 14 paths
and two browsers, each page has exactly one `main[role=main][data-testid=page]`.

This version differs from the first draft (fix round 1 of Task 11 and the final fix wave): fix round 1 changed the accessible name of
the workspace select button to follow the new dictionary, split the top bar test in two, and added the test "the + New button
opens the new project screen of the workspace in the path, not that of HOME" (the old test was named "takes the
workspace from the shell data" but did not prove that); the final fix wave added the assertion
`role="main"` of the `page` region.

Five places that differ from the tables in the steps above, which the review accepted. One: the `Main` frame of the sidebar and the menu
`Workspaces` are found with `getByLabelText` and then the `role` prop is asserted, not with
`getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main' })` or `getByRole('menu', { name: 'Workspaces' })`; the reason
is as in Task 6 (`*ByRole` of RNTL matches only accessible elements, and `accessible` on a frame
that contains items would hide the items inside from VoiceOver). Two: the name of a link is matched by a regular expression
(`/My focus 9$/`), because RNTL keeps even the `aria-hidden` glyph in the name, so the name is `◎ My focus 9`, and
not `My focus 9`. Three: `NavItem` is a discriminated union on `kind` (a link has `route` and
`tag: null`; the two not-built kinds have `route: null` and `tag`) and `groups` is a fixed triple Home,
Portfolio, Workspace (`satisfies [NavGroup, NavGroup, NavGroup]`), so the code needs no type cast
of any kind. Four: `Sidebar` turns the `route` of the model into the `href` of the `Menu` items. Five: the 300-line cap of
`max-lines` forces the tests to be split: `model.test.ts` into three files (adding `model.sidebar.test.ts`,
`model.header.test.ts`), `Sidebar.test.native.tsx` into two (the project tree and workspace selection go to
`Sidebar.tree.test.native.tsx`), and fix round 1 added `model.workspace.test.ts`. Every test that uses
`renderRouter` sits in a `describe` with `afterEach(jest.useRealTimers)` running before the cleanup
of RNTL (same reason as the tests of `Button`, Task 5); `Shell.test.native.tsx` alone switches to
real timers as soon as `renderRouter` returns (`mountLoaded`), because seven tests that wait for data from the fake
server hang in the dry run of Stryker.

Between Task 11 and Task 13, ten of the twenty browser tests were red, because `NotBuilt` already needed
`LocaleProvider` and `_layout.tsx` did not wrap it yet (error "useLocale needs a LocaleProvider above it").
The controller accepted that gap because `pnpm verify` had no browser gate yet, and Task 13 had to bring
all twenty back to green. The `gate:mutation` of this task took 20 minutes 24 seconds (7 minutes 57 seconds before): it added
248 mutants, and the tests with a router run slowly.

Fix round 1 after the review changed five places of the first submission, and the tables above follow the fixed version. One:
`useShell` drops the late answer of the old request (the `current` flag). Two: the workspace picker is rebuilt per
path (`key={pathname}`) so the menu closes by itself when the page changes. Three: a not-built item always shows its label, the
count does not hide it. Four: the test of `Shell` proves the + New button follows the workspace of the path. Five:
the accessible name of the workspace select button starts with the text visible on the button (WCAG 2.5.3), so the key of the
dictionary becomes `{tenant} {workspace}, choose a workspace` (Vietnamese `{tenant} {workspace}, choose a
workspace`; the block of Task 9 already follows). The final fix wave after the whole-branch review changed two more places:
`zIndex: 1` for the frame that wraps the workspace picker (the menu was rendered under the rows of the sidebar) and
`role="main"` moved from `NotBuilt` up to the `ScrollView` of `Shell`.

```ts
import { act, renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native'
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw'
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node'

import type { ApiResult } from '../../core/api/client'
import type { Overview } from '../../core/api/overview'
import { meridian } from '../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { showroom } from '../../mocks/fixtures/showroom'
import { handlersFor } from '../../mocks/handlers'
import { useOverview } from './useOverview'

const OVERVIEW = 'https://api.metis.test/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects/:projectId/overview'
// Handlers are registered inside each test (beforeEach), not when the file loads: Stryker assigns coverage to
// exactly the right test, and does not treat a mutant of handlers.ts as a static mutant.
const server = setupServer()
beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' }))
beforeEach(() => server.use(...handlersFor('default')))
afterEach(() => server.resetHandlers())
afterAll(() => server.close())

type Props = { project: string; scope: 'project' | 'mine' }
// Record the value of result on every render (see useShell.test.native.ts).
const mount = (initialProps: Props) => {
  const seen: (ApiResult<Overview> | null)[] = []
  const hook = renderHook(
    ({ project, scope }: Props) => {
      const value = useOverview('creative-studio', project, scope)
      seen.push(value.result)
      return value
    },
    { initialProps }
  )
  return { seen, hook }
}

test('the first render is null (loading), then the data of the project', async () => {
  const { seen, hook } = mount({ project: 'meridian-cgi-campaign', scope: 'project' })
  const { result } = await hook
  expect(seen[0]).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: meridian }))
})

test('changing the project or the scope: asks again, the first render after the change is null', async () => {
  const scopes: string[] = []
  server.use(
    http.get(OVERVIEW, ({ request, params }) => {
      scopes.push(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('scope') ?? 'project')
      return HttpResponse.json(params.projectId === 'northwind-showroom-vr' ? showroom : meridian)
    })
  )
  const { seen, hook } = mount({ project: 'meridian-cgi-campaign', scope: 'project' })
  const { result, rerender } = await hook
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: meridian }))
  seen.length = 0
  await rerender({ project: 'northwind-showroom-vr', scope: 'project' })
  expect(seen[0]).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: showroom }))
  seen.length = 0
  await rerender({ project: 'northwind-showroom-vr', scope: 'mine' })
  expect(seen[0]).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(scopes).toEqual(['project', 'project', 'mine']))
})

test('a client error reaches the screen unchanged; retry asks again on every press', async () => {
  let calls = 0
  server.use(
    http.get(OVERVIEW, () => {
      calls += 1
      return calls === 1 ? new HttpResponse(null, { status: 500 }) : HttpResponse.json(meridian)
    })
  )
  const { result } = await mount({ project: 'meridian-cgi-campaign', scope: 'project' }).hook
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: { kind: 'server', status: 500 } })
  )
  await act(async () => result.current.retry())
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: meridian }))
  await act(async () => result.current.retry())
  await waitFor(() => expect(calls).toBe(3))
})
```

Expected when running `pnpm exec jest --ci --selectProjects iOS Android --testPathPattern 'useOverview'`: exit
1, `Cannot find module './useOverview'`. Then `useOverview.ts` (the key of the request holds project, scope,
attempt; the answer carries that key so an old answer does not show for a new request; the `n - 1` mutant of
`retry` is equivalent so it is disabled with a reason):

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { type ApiResult, getOverview, type Scope } from '../../core/api/client'
import type { Overview } from '../../core/api/overview'
import { apiConfig } from '../../platform/config'

// The data of screen 24 (spec 3.3); result is null while loading. The answer carries the key of the request
// (project, scope, attempt), so an old answer never shows for a new request; retry asks again.
export function useOverview(workspaceId: string, projectId: string, scope: Scope) {
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0)
  const key = JSON.stringify([workspaceId, projectId, scope, attempt])
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState<{ key: string; result: ApiResult<Overview> } | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    getOverview(apiConfig, workspaceId, projectId, scope).then((result) =>
      setAnswer({ key, result })
    )
  }, [key, workspaceId, projectId, scope])
  return {
    result: answer?.key === key ? answer.result : null,
    // Stryker disable next-line ArithmeticOperator: any number other than the old one changes the key, n - 1 too
    retry: () => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)
  }
}
```

`src/screens/24-project-overview/useOverview.ts`:

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'

import { type ApiResult, getOverview, type Scope } from '../../core/api/client'
import type { Overview } from '../../core/api/overview'
import { apiConfig } from '../../platform/config'

// Data of screen 24 (spec 3.3); result is null while loading. The answer carries the key of the request
// (project, scope, attempt), so an old answer never shows for a new request; retry asks again.
export function useOverview(workspaceId: string, projectId: string, scope: Scope) {
  const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0)
  const key = JSON.stringify([workspaceId, projectId, scope, attempt])
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState<{ key: string; result: ApiResult<Overview> } | null>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    // When the key changes (or the screen is left) the old request is dropped: its slow answer must not overwrite the answer
    // of the new request, because then the key of the answer differs from the current key and the page is stuck loading.
    let current = true
    getOverview(apiConfig, workspaceId, projectId, scope).then((result) => {
      if (current) setAnswer({ key, result })
    })
    return () => {
      current = false
    }
  }, [key, workspaceId, projectId, scope])
  return {
    result: answer?.key === key ? answer.result : null,
    // Stryker disable next-line ArithmeticOperator: any number other than the old one changes the key, and n - 1 does too
    retry: () => setAttempt((n) => n + 1)
  }
}
```

This version differs from the first draft (fix round 1 of Task 12): the effect keeps a `current` flag and drops the answer
of the old request. In the first version, a slow answer of the old project that arrives after the answer of the new project overwrites it;
the key of the answer differs from the current key, so the page stays stuck in the loading state forever (`aria-busy` true).
The review measured: after the fast answer it is Showroom, after the slow answer it is `null`.

```ts
  expect(seen[0]).toBeNull()
  await waitFor(() => expect(scopes).toEqual(['project', 'project', 'mine']))
})

test('a client error reaches the screen unchanged; retry asks again on every press', async () => {
  let calls = 0
  server.use(
    http.get(OVERVIEW, () => {
      calls += 1
      return calls === 1 ? new HttpResponse(null, { status: 500 }) : HttpResponse.json(meridian)
    })
  )
  const { result } = await mount({ project: 'meridian-cgi-campaign', scope: 'project' }).hook
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: false, error: { kind: 'server', status: 500 } })
  )
  await act(async () => result.current.retry())
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: meridian }))
  await act(async () => result.current.retry())
  await waitFor(() => expect(calls).toBe(3))
})

test('a slow answer of an old request that arrives after the answer of a new request is dropped and does not overwrite it', async () => {
  server.use(
    http.get(OVERVIEW, async ({ params }) => {
      // Meridian answers 400 ms late, Showroom answers at once: the answer of Meridian arrives after the answer of Showroom.
      if (params.projectId === 'meridian-cgi-campaign') {
        await delay(400)
        return HttpResponse.json(meridian)
      }
      return HttpResponse.json(showroom)
    })
  )
  const { hook } = mount({ project: 'meridian-cgi-campaign', scope: 'project' })
  const { result, rerender } = await hook
  await rerender({ project: 'northwind-showroom-vr', scope: 'project' })
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: showroom }))
  // Wait past the moment the answer of Meridian arrives (400 ms): it has been dropped, the result is still that of Showroom.
  await act(async () => {
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 800))
  })
  expect(result.current.result).toEqual({ ok: true, data: showroom })
})
```

This version differs from the first draft (fix round 1 of Task 12): it adds a fourth test, a slow answer of an old
request that arrives after the answer of a new request is dropped (Meridian answers after 400 ms, Showroom answers at once; wait
800 ms for real and the result is still Showroom), and `delay` from msw goes into the import list. The test is red on the
old hook (`Received: null`). The hook now has four tests, so Step 1 runs out to `Tests: 8 passed, 8 total`
(two projects), not six.

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import type { Scope } from '../../core/api/client'
import type { Overview } from '../../core/api/overview'
import { useLocale } from '../../shell/locale'
import { projectHeaderOf } from '../../shell/model'
import { ProjectHeader } from '../../shell/ProjectHeader'
import { STRINGS as SHELL_STRINGS } from '../../shell/strings'
import { CategoryCard } from './blocks/CategoryCard'
import { HealthCard } from './blocks/HealthCard'
import { HeaderRow } from './blocks/HeaderRow'
import { ListCards } from './blocks/ListCards'
import { ProgressCard } from './blocks/ProgressCard'
import { StatusCard } from './blocks/StatusCard'
import { TileRow } from './blocks/TileRow'
import { WorkloadCard } from './blocks/WorkloadCard'
import { buildOverview, problemOf } from './model'
import { styles } from './Screen.styles'
import { StateView } from './states/StateView'
import { STRINGS } from './strings'
import { useOverview } from './useOverview'

type Ids = { workspaceId: string; projectId: string }

// The data has arrived (spec 4.2): the project header, then the page body of five rows. The screen does not format and
// does not compute anything (spec 3.3): all text and numbers come from buildOverview, the header from projectHeaderOf.
function Loaded({ data, scope, workspaceId, projectId }: Ids & { data: Overview; scope: Scope }) {
  const { locale } = useLocale()
  const header = projectHeaderOf(data.project, {
    locale,
    strings: SHELL_STRINGS[locale],
    timeZone: data.timeZone,
    workspaceId,
    projectId
  })
  const model = buildOverview(data, {
    locale,
    strings: STRINGS[locale],
    workspaceId,
    projectId,
    scope
  })
  return (
    <>
      <ProjectHeader header={header} />
      <View testID="overview-body" style={styles.body}>
        <HeaderRow model={model} />
        <TileRow tiles={model.tiles} />
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <ProgressCard progress={model.progress} />
          <StatusCard status={model.status} />
          <HealthCard health={model.health} />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <CategoryCard rows={model.categories} titles={model.titles} />
          <WorkloadCard rows={model.workload} titles={model.titles} />
        </View>
        <View style={styles.row}>
          <ListCards upcoming={model.upcoming} overdue={model.overdue} risks={model.risks} />
        </View>
      </View>
    </>
  )
}

// Screen 24, project overview (spec 4.2). Any scope other than "mine" is "project" (R-B4). The root reports busy while
// there is no answer yet, so pressing Try again changes aria-busy from false to true (contract, state-retry).
// An error has no project header: 403 and 404 have no data to draw it.
export function OverviewScreen({
  workspaceId,
  projectId,
  scope
}: Ids & { scope: string | undefined }) {
  const { locale } = useLocale()
  const range = scope === 'mine' ? 'mine' : 'project'
  const { result, retry } = useOverview(workspaceId, projectId, range)
  const strings = STRINGS[locale]
  return (
    <View testID="overview" aria-busy={result === null}>
      {result?.ok ? (
        <Loaded data={result.data} scope={range} workspaceId={workspaceId} projectId={projectId} />
      ) : (
        <StateView
          problem={result === null ? null : problemOf(result.error, strings)}
          loading={strings.states.loading}
          onRetry={retry}
        />
      )}
    </View>
  )
}
```

```tsx
// Route of screen 24 as in src/app (Task 13): reads the parameters of the path and hands them to the screen.

    projectId: string

// A test that waits for data from the fake server needs the real clock: renderRouter turns the fake clock on, and under
```

This version differs from the first draft (fix round 1 of Task 12): four test names gain requirement codes (`OVW-01 BR-24
BR-39`, `OVW-01 OVW-02 OVW-03 OVW-05`, `OVW-01 BR-39`, `BR-39 OVW-02`), only the names change, not the
content. The first version had BR-24 and BR-39 in no name, against spec 9.1 rule 5; now all eight codes of the contract are
present in at least one name (BR-24 in one name, BR-39 in three names). Nine names stay without a code (two of the scope, seven
of the pure states, counting both name patterns of `test.each`), because they match no code of the contract.

```tsx
  jest.mocked(readLocale).mockReturnValue('en')
})

// Route of screen 24 as in src/app (Task 13): reads the parameters of the path and hands them to the screen.

  const { workspaceId, projectId, scope } = useLocalSearchParams<{
    workspaceId: string

// The fake server holds the answer until the test releases it, so that the loading render can be seen. Every test

const hold = (answer: () => Response) => {
  let release = () => {}

  })

// renderRouter turns on the fake clock of Jest and does not turn it off; under Stryker the automatic cleanup of RNTL hangs

describe('Screen: states', () => {
  afterEach(() => {

      release = resolve
    })

    expect(screen.getByTestId('overview')).toHaveProp('aria-busy', false)

    expect(
      within(panel).getByText(

    expect(screen.queryByTestId('project-header')).toBeNull()

  test('session expired: the Your session expired dialog replaces the whole page, no project header', async () => {
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'
import { Slot, useLocalSearchParams } from 'expo-router'
import { renderRouter } from 'expo-router/testing-library'
import { http, HttpResponse } from 'msw'
import { setupServer } from 'msw/node'
import { Text } from 'react-native'

import { meridian } from '../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { handlersFor } from '../../mocks/handlers'
import { readLocale } from '../../platform/storage'
import { LocaleProvider } from '../../shell/locale'
import { OverviewScreen } from './Screen'

jest.mock('../../platform/storage', () => ({ readLocale: jest.fn(), writeLocale: jest.fn() }))

const OVERVIEW = 'https://api.metis.test/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects/:projectId/overview'
const PROJECT = '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign'
const MERIDIAN = `${PROJECT}/overview`

// Handlers are registered inside each test (beforeEach), not when the file loads: Stryker assigns coverage to
// the right test and does not treat a mutant of handlers.ts as a static mutant.
const server = setupServer()
beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledRequest: 'error' }))
beforeEach(() => {
  server.use(...handlersFor('default'))
  jest.mocked(readLocale).mockReturnValue('en')
})
afterEach(() => {
  server.resetHandlers()
  jest.clearAllMocks()
})
afterAll(() => server.close())

// Target page of the links: records the parameters it receives.
function Params() {
  return <Text testID="params">{JSON.stringify(useLocalSearchParams())}</Text>
}

// Route of screen 24 as in src/app (Task 13): reads the parameters of the path and hands them to the screen.
function OverviewRoute() {
  const { workspaceId, projectId, scope } = useLocalSearchParams<{
    workspaceId: string
    projectId: string
    scope?: string
  }>()
  return <OverviewScreen workspaceId={workspaceId} projectId={projectId} scope={scope} />
}

// A test that waits for data from the fake server needs the real clock: renderRouter turns the fake clock on, and under
// Stryker (jsdom, no setImmediate) the wait loop of RNTL relies on the setTimeout of the fake clock and so hangs
// until 5 seconds are up (see Shell.test.native.tsx). The frame has finished drawing synchronously when renderRouter returns, so
// the clock is switched right after that.
const mount = (initialUrl: string) => {
  const result = renderRouter(
    {
      _layout: () => (
        <LocaleProvider>
          <Slot />
        </LocaleProvider>
      ),
      'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/overview': OverviewRoute,
      'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/wbs/index': Params,
      'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/wbs/[itemId]': Params,
      'w/[workspaceId]/projects/[projectId]/focus': Params
    },
    { initialUrl }
  )
  jest.useRealTimers()
  return result
}

// renderRouter turns on the fake clock of Jest and does not turn it off; under Stryker the automatic cleanup of RNTL hangs
// until 5 seconds are up (see Button.test.native.tsx). The afterEach of the nested block runs before the afterEach of the
// outer block, so the real clock is restored before that cleanup.
describe('Screen: links and controls', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    jest.useRealTimers()
  })

  test('OVW-01 BR-32: the Blocked tile is a link; pressing it goes to the WBS of the project with the filter status=blocked', async () => {
    const router = mount(MERIDIAN)
    await router
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

    const tile = screen.getByTestId('tile-blocked')
    expect(tile).toHaveProp('role', 'link')
    await fireEvent.press(tile)

    expect(router.getPathname()).toBe(`${PROJECT}/wbs`)
    expect(JSON.parse(screen.getByTestId('params').children.join(''))).toMatchObject({
      status: 'blocked'
    })
  })

  test('OVW-02 Table view button: before pressing there is a chart; pressing shows a table of five rows; pressing again returns to the chart', async () => {
    await mount(MERIDIAN)
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

    const toggle = screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')
    expect(toggle).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', false)
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status-done')).toBeOnTheScreen()

    await fireEvent.press(toggle)

    expect(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', true)
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status-table').children).toHaveLength(6)
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-done')).toBeNull()

    await fireEvent.press(toggle)

    expect(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', false)
    expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-table')).toBeNull()
    expect(screen.getByTestId('status-done')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  })

  test('OVW-03 OVW-04 lists: an empty upcoming list has a sentence saying why; an overdue row opens the page of the item', async () => {
    const router = mount(MERIDIAN)
    await router
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

    expect(
      screen.getByText('None due from today. 3 milestones and 2 gates are overdue (see Overdue).')
    ).toBeOnTheScreen()
    const row = screen.getByTestId('overdue-row-item-1.1.1')
    expect(row).toHaveProp('role', 'link')
    await fireEvent.press(row)

    expect(router.getPathname()).toBe(`${PROJECT}/wbs/item-1.1.1`)
    expect(JSON.parse(screen.getByTestId('params').children.join(''))).toMatchObject({
      itemId: 'item-1.1.1'
    })
  })

  test('OVW-04 the "+ 5 more" row of Overdue opens the Focus of the project', async () => {
    const router = mount(MERIDIAN)
    await router
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('overdue-more'))

    expect(router.getPathname()).toBe(`${PROJECT}/focus`)
  })

  test('OVW-05 health: declared At risk is better than the computed Off track, so there is a warning strip', async () => {
    await mount(MERIDIAN)
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

    const warning = screen.getByTestId('health-warning')
    expect(
      within(warning).getByText(
        'Declared health is better than computed. Delivery: 9 overdue items including 3 milestones. Risk: 1 critical risk without mitigation.'
      )
    ).toBeOnTheScreen()
  })

  test('R-B4 scope: pressing My items writes scope=mine onto the path, the fake server receives ?scope=mine, the figures do not change', async () => {
    const scopes: (string | null)[] = []
    server.use(
      http.get(OVERVIEW, ({ request }) => {
        scopes.push(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('scope'))
        return HttpResponse.json(meridian)
      })
    )
    const router = mount(MERIDIAN)
    await router
    await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')
    expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-project')).toBeSelected()
    expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-mine')).not.toBeSelected()
    expect(scopes).toEqual([null])

    await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('scope-mine'))

    expect(router.getPathnameWithParams()).toBe(`${MERIDIAN}?scope=mine`)
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-mine')).toBeSelected())
    expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-project')).not.toBeSelected()
    expect(scopes).toEqual([null, 'mine'])
    expect(within(screen.getByTestId('tile-workItems')).getByText('12')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  })

  test.each([
    ['mine', 'scope-mine', 'mine'],
    ['other', 'scope-project', null]
  ] as const)(
    'scope=%s parameter of the path: option %s is selected, the fake server receives scope %s',
    async (scope, selected, sent) => {
      const scopes: (string | null)[] = []
      server.use(
        http.get(OVERVIEW, ({ request }) => {
          scopes.push(new URL(request.url).searchParams.get('scope'))
          return HttpResponse.json(meridian)
        })
      )
      await mount(`${MERIDIAN}?scope=${scope}`)
      await screen.findByTestId('overview-body')

      expect(screen.getByTestId(selected)).toBeSelected()
      expect(scopes).toEqual([sent])
    }
  )
})
```

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Glyph } from '../../../design-system/Glyph'
import { Segmented } from '../../../design-system/Segmented'
import { Tag } from '../../../design-system/Tag'
import { Text } from '../../../design-system/Text'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './HeaderRow.styles'

// Symbol, size and color of the freshness (css:298-302): only stale colors the text with waitingText. The symbol is only for
// decoration, because the text already states the freshness (BR-39: shape, text and time, never color alone).
const FRESH = {
  fresh: { glyph: 'freshFresh', size: 'dot', tone: 'good', text: 'muted' },
  stale: { glyph: 'freshStale', size: 'badge', tone: 'waiting', text: 'waitingText' },
  partial: { glyph: 'freshPartial', size: 'badge', tone: 'running', text: 'muted' },
  unknown: { glyph: 'freshUnknown', size: 'badge', tone: 'muted', text: 'muted' }
} as const

// Top row of screen 24 (html:19-22): the title, the freshness and the scope sentence; the scope selector and Export.
export function HeaderRow({ model }: { model: ReturnType<typeof buildOverview> }) {
  const fresh = FRESH[model.freshness.tone]
  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      <View testID="overview-heading" style={styles.heading}>
        <Text variant="pageTitle" heading={2}>
          {model.title}
        </Text>
        <View testID="freshness" style={styles.freshness}>
          <Glyph name={fresh.glyph} size={fresh.size} tone={fresh.tone} />
          <Text variant="fresh" tone={fresh.text}>
            {model.freshness.text}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
          {model.scopeNote}
        </Text>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.tools}>
        <Segmented
          label={model.scope.label}
          options={model.scope.options.map((option) => ({
            label: option.label,
            href: option.route,
            selected: option.scope === model.scope.active,
            testID: `scope-${option.scope}`
          }))}
        />
        <View testID="export" style={styles.export}>
          <Text variant="control">{model.exportLabel.label}</Text>
          <Tag variant="label">{model.exportLabel.note}</Tag>
        </View>
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'

import type { Scope } from '../../../core/api/client'
import { tokens } from '../../../design-system/tokens'
import { meridian } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { STRINGS } from '../strings'
import { HeaderRow } from './HeaderRow'

// The symbols of Glyph are hidden from the screen reader (aria-hidden), so the text query has to reach them.
const HIDDEN = { includeHiddenElements: true }

// Build the model inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs when the file loads is a static mutant of Stryker).
const modelOf = (scope: Scope = 'project') =>
  buildOverview(meridian, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    scope
  })

// The four freshness states (css:298-302): symbol, size, symbol color, text color. Only stale colors the text with waitingText.
const FRESHNESS = [
  ['fresh', '●', tokens.fsDot, tokens.good, tokens.muted],
  ['stale', '▲', tokens.fsBadge, tokens.waiting, tokens.waitingText],
  ['partial', '◐', tokens.fsBadge, tokens.running, tokens.muted],
  ['unknown', '?', tokens.fsBadge, tokens.muted, tokens.muted]
] as const

test('top row of the screen: level 2 title, freshness, scope sentence on the left; scope and Export on the right', async () => {
  await render(<HeaderRow model={modelOf()} />)

  const left = screen.getByTestId('overview-heading')
  expect(left.parent).toHaveStyle({
    flexDirection: 'row',
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    gap: tokens.space10
  })
  expect(left).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space10 })
  const title = within(left).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Overview' })
  expect(title).toHaveProp('aria-level', 2)
  expect(title).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsH2, fontWeight: '600' })
  const note = within(left).getByText('12 work items · Category rows excluded')
  expect(note).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall, color: tokens.muted })
  expect(left.children).toEqual([title, screen.getByTestId('freshness'), note])
  const right = screen.getByLabelText('Scope').parent
  expect(left.parent?.children).toEqual([left, right])
  expect(right).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space10 })
  expect(right?.children).toEqual([screen.getByLabelText('Scope'), screen.getByTestId('export')])
})

test('Meridian freshness: a row spaced by space5, a green dot of size dot then gray text of size fresh, with the time and the version', async () => {
  await render(<HeaderRow model={modelOf()} />)

  const freshness = screen.getByTestId('freshness')
  expect(freshness).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space5 })
  expect(within(freshness).getByText('●', HIDDEN)).toHaveStyle({
    color: tokens.good,
    fontSize: tokens.fsDot
  })
  const text = within(freshness).getByText('As of 22 Sept 2026, 09:40 · metrics v1')
  expect(text).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.muted, fontSize: tokens.fsTag })
  expect(freshness.children).toEqual([within(freshness).getByText('●', HIDDEN), text])
})

test.each(FRESHNESS)(
  'freshness %s: symbol %s size %s color %s, text color %s',
  async (tone, mark, size, markColor, textColor) => {
    await render(
      <HeaderRow model={{ ...modelOf(), freshness: { tone, text: `Freshness ${tone}` } }} />
    )

    const freshness = screen.getByTestId('freshness')
    expect(within(freshness).getByText(mark, HIDDEN)).toHaveStyle({
      color: markColor,
      fontSize: size
    })
    expect(within(freshness).getByText(`Freshness ${tone}`)).toHaveStyle({ color: textColor })
    // The symbol is only decoration: the text already states the freshness, so the screen reader does not read it.
    expect(within(freshness).getByText(mark, HIDDEN)).toHaveProp('aria-hidden', true)
    expect(within(freshness).queryByText(mark)).toBeNull()
  }
)

test('scope This project: the This project option is selected, each option opens exactly the route of the model', async () => {
  await render(<HeaderRow model={modelOf()} />)

  const group = screen.getByLabelText('Scope')
  expect(group).toHaveProp('role', 'tablist')
  const project = within(group).getByTestId('scope-project')
  const mine = within(group).getByTestId('scope-mine')
  expect(project).toBeSelected()
  expect(mine).not.toBeSelected()
  expect(within(project).getByText('This project')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  expect(within(mine).getByText('My items')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  expect(project).toHaveProp('href', '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign/overview')
  expect(mine).toHaveProp(
    'href',
    '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign/overview?scope=mine'
  )
  expect(group.children).toEqual([project, mine])
})

test('scope My items: the My items option is selected, the other one is not', async () => {
  await render(<HeaderRow model={modelOf('mine')} />)

  expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-mine')).toBeSelected()
  expect(screen.getByTestId('scope-project')).not.toBeSelected()
})

test('Export is text with a Not built yet label, and cannot be pressed', async () => {
  await render(<HeaderRow model={modelOf()} />)

  const label = screen.getByTestId('export')
  expect(label).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', alignItems: 'center', gap: tokens.space5 })
  expect(within(label).getByText('Export')).toHaveStyle({
    fontFamily: 'Manrope',
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: tokens.text
  })
  expect(within(label).getByText('Not built yet')).toHaveStyle({
    color: tokens.accent,
    fontSize: tokens.fsBadge
  })
  expect(label.props.role).toBeUndefined()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('button')).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('link')).toBeNull()
})
```

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Tile } from '../../../design-system/Tile'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './TileRow.styles'

// Eight metric tiles (html:25-32), each tile a link that drills down into the filtered WBS (BR-32).
export function TileRow({ tiles }: { tiles: ReturnType<typeof buildOverview>['tiles'] }) {
  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      {tiles.map((tile) => (
        <Tile
          key={tile.id}
          label={tile.label}
          value={tile.value}
          figure={tile.figure}
          delta={tile.delta}
          alert={tile.alert}
          href={tile.route}
          testID={`tile-${tile.id}`}
        />
      ))}
    </View>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'

import type { Overview } from '../../../core/api/overview'
import { tokens } from '../../../design-system/tokens'
import { meridian } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { showroom } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/showroom'
import { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { STRINGS } from '../strings'
import { TileRow } from './TileRow'

const WBS = '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign/wbs'

// Build the model inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs when the file loads is a static mutant of Stryker).
const tilesOf = (data: Overview = meridian) =>
  buildOverview(data, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    scope: 'project'
  }).tiles

// Eight tiles in the order of the wireframe (html:25-32): id, label, number, route it opens (the filter of the server). A filter
// with several values goes into the path as one value joined by commas: expo-router writes
// encodeURIComponent(array.toString()) (build/link/href.js:80-84), hence risk=high%2Ccritical.
const TILES = [
  ['workItems', 'Work items', '12', WBS],
  ['deliverables', 'Deliverables', '3', `${WBS}?type=deliverable`],
  ['workPackages', 'Work packages', '2', `${WBS}?type=workPackage`],
  ['milestones', 'Milestones', '3', `${WBS}?label=milestone`],
  ['approvalGates', 'Approval gates', '2', `${WBS}?label=approvalGate`],
  ['blocked', 'Blocked', '0', `${WBS}?status=blocked`],
  ['delayed', 'Delayed vs baseline', '2', `${WBS}?delayed=true`],
  ['highRisk', 'High risk', '4', `${WBS}?risk=high%2Ccritical`]
] as const

test('eight tiles on one row separated by gap, in the order of the wireframe, each tile a link tile-<id>', async () => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf()} />)

  const tiles = screen.getAllByRole('link')
  expect(tiles.map((tile) => tile.props.testID)).toEqual(TILES.map(([id]) => `tile-${id}`))
  expect(tiles[0]?.parent).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', gap: tokens.gap })
  expect(tiles[0]?.parent?.children).toHaveLength(8)
})

test.each(TILES)('tile %s: label %s, number %s, opens %s', async (id, label, value, href) => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf()} />)

  const tile = screen.getByTestId(`tile-${id}`)
  expect(tile).toHaveProp('role', 'link')
  expect(tile).toHaveProp('href', href)
  expect(within(tile).getByText(label)).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.muted })
  expect(within(tile).getByText(value)).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsFigure })
})

// The sub-lines of Meridian (html:25-32): the text of each tile that has a sub-line, by tile id.
const DELTAS = [
  ['workItems', '6 category rows not counted'],
  ['deliverables', 'Type = Deliverable'],
  ['milestones', '3 overdue'],
  ['approvalGates', '2 overdue'],
  ['delayed', '+2 since baseline v1'],
  ['highRisk', '1 critical']
] as const

test.each(DELTAS)('tile %s has the sub-line "%s", in gray text of size caption', async (id, text) => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf()} />)

  const tile = screen.getByTestId(`tile-${id}`)
  expect(within(tile).getByText(text)).toHaveStyle({
    color: tokens.muted,
    fontSize: tokens.fsCaption
  })
  expect(tile.children).toHaveLength(3)
})

test('the Delayed tile colors the increase +2 in dark red; Work packages and Blocked have no sub-line', async () => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf()} />)

  expect(within(screen.getByTestId('tile-delayed')).getByText('+2')).toHaveStyle({
    color: tokens.criticalText,
    fontWeight: '600'
  })
  // A tile without a sub-line has only the label and the frame of the number.
  expect(screen.getByTestId('tile-workPackages').children).toHaveLength(2)
  expect(screen.getByTestId('tile-blocked').children).toHaveLength(2)
})

test('a tile stands out with a red border and a red number: Delayed and High risk of Meridian; Blocked 0 and the other tiles do not', async () => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf()} />)

  const alerts: string[] = ['delayed', 'highRisk']
  for (const [id] of TILES) {
    const alert = alerts.includes(id)
    const tile = screen.getByTestId(`tile-${id}`)
    expect(tile).toHaveStyle({ borderColor: alert ? tokens.critical : tokens.line })
    expect(within(tile).getByText(/^\d+$/)).toHaveStyle({
      color: alert ? tokens.criticalText : tokens.text
    })
  }
})

test('Showroom has no baseline yet: the Delayed tile is the text Not baselined, does not stand out, has no sub-line', async () => {
  await render(<TileRow tiles={tilesOf(showroom)} />)

  const delayed = screen.getByTestId('tile-delayed')
  expect(within(delayed).getByText('Not baselined')).toHaveStyle({
    fontSize: tokens.fsBody,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: tokens.muted
  })
  expect(delayed).toHaveStyle({ borderColor: tokens.line })
  expect(delayed.children).toHaveLength(2)
  // High risk 0: does not stand out, no "critical".
  expect(screen.getByTestId('tile-highRisk')).toHaveStyle({ borderColor: tokens.line })
  expect(screen.queryByText(/critical/)).toBeNull()
})
```

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Card } from '../../../design-system/Card'
import { Meter } from '../../../design-system/Meter'
import { Text } from '../../../design-system/Text'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './ProgressCard.styles'

// Overall progress (html:36-43): a single number, so it is a bar and not a pie chart. The text and numbers are those of the
// model, the screen does not multiply and does not round (FE-20).
export function ProgressCard({
  progress
}: {
  progress: ReturnType<typeof buildOverview>['progress']
}) {
  return (
    <Card title={progress.title}>
      <View style={styles.body}>
        <View style={styles.figure}>
          <Text variant="percent">{progress.percent}</Text>
          <Text variant="body" tone="muted">
            {progress.caption}
          </Text>
        </View>
        <Meter value={progress.value} label={progress.caption} />
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
          {progress.note}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Button } from '../../../design-system/Button'
import { Card } from '../../../design-system/Card'
import { Legend } from '../../../design-system/Legend'
import { StackBar } from '../../../design-system/StackBar'
import { Text } from '../../../design-system/Text'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './StatusCard.styles'

type Status = ReturnType<typeof buildOverview>['status']

// Stacked bar and legend. A segment of the model carries no text, so the text of a segment is the legend line of the same
// status; a status of 0 has a legend line but no segment.
function StatusChart({ status }: { status: Status }) {
  const segments = status.rows.flatMap((row) => {
    const segment = status.segments.find((candidate) => candidate.status === row.status)
    if (segment === undefined) return []
    return [
      {
        status: row.status,
        weight: segment.weight,
        href: segment.route,
        label: row.legend,
        testID: `status-${row.status}`
      }
    ]
  })
  return (
    <>
      <StackBar segments={segments} />
      <Legend items={status.rows.map((row) => ({ status: row.status, text: row.legend }))} />
    </>
  )
}

// Table form of the same figures (OVW-02): one header row, then one row per status, the status with 0 included.
function StatusTable({ status }: { status: Status }) {
  return (
    <View role="table" testID="status-table" style={styles.table}>
      <View role="row" style={styles.row}>
        <View role="columnheader" style={styles.cell}>
          <Text variant="small">{status.columns.status}</Text>
        </View>
        <View role="columnheader" style={styles.cell}>
          <Text variant="small">{status.columns.count}</Text>
        </View>
      </View>
      {status.rows.map((row) => (
        <View key={row.status} role="row" style={styles.row}>
          <View role="cell" style={styles.cell}>
            <Text variant="small">{row.name}</Text>
          </View>
          <View role="cell" style={styles.cell}>
            <Text variant="small">{row.count}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  )
}

// Breakdown by status (html:44-50): the chart, or the table when Table view is pressed. Chart or table is
// the state of this card alone.
export function StatusCard({ status }: { status: Status }) {
  const [table, setTable] = useState(false)
  return (
    <Card
      title={status.title}
      aside={
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          label={status.tableView}
          pressed={table}
          onPress={() => setTable(!table)}
          testID="status-table-view"
        />
      }
    >
      <View style={styles.body}>
        {table ? <StatusTable status={status} /> : <StatusChart status={status} />}
      </View>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```tsx
import { fireEvent, render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'
import type { TestInstance } from 'test-renderer'

import type { Overview } from '../../../core/api/overview'
import { tokens } from '../../../design-system/tokens'
import { meridian } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { showroom } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/showroom'
import { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { STRINGS } from '../strings'
import { StatusCard } from './StatusCard'

const WBS = '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign/wbs'

// Build the model inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs when the file loads is a static mutant of Stryker).
const statusOf = (data: Overview = meridian) =>
  buildOverview(data, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    scope: 'project'
  }).status

// The four segments of Meridian (Blocked 0 has no segment): id, name, relative width, route it opens.
const SEGMENTS = [
  ['status-done', 'Done 3', 3, `${WBS}?status=done`],
  ['status-inProgress', 'In Progress 3', 3, `${WBS}?status=inProgress`],
  ['status-waiting', 'Waiting 1', 1, `${WBS}?status=waiting`],
  ['status-notStarted', 'Not Started 5', 5, `${WBS}?status=notStarted`]
] as const

// The five rows of the table (Blocked 0 still has a row): name and number.
const TABLE = [
  ['Done', '3'],
  ['In Progress', '3'],
  ['Waiting', '1'],
  ['Blocked', '0'],
  ['Not Started', '5']
] as const

const LEGEND = ['Done 3', 'In Progress 3', 'Waiting 1', 'Blocked 0', 'Not Started 5']

test('default chart form: level 3 title, the Table view button not pressed, the bar then the legend in a space8 column', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Status breakdown' })).toHaveProp('aria-level', 3)
  const toggle = screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')
  expect(toggle).toHaveProp('role', 'button')
  expect(toggle).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', false)
  expect(within(toggle).getByText('Table view')).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.muted })
  const bar = screen.getAllByRole('link')[0]?.parent
  expect(bar).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', height: tokens.barH, gap: tokens.space2 })
  const column = bar?.parent
  expect(column).toHaveStyle({ gap: tokens.space8 })
  expect(column?.children).toHaveLength(2)
  expect(column?.children[0]).toBe(bar)
  expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-table')).toBeNull()
})

test.each(SEGMENTS)('segment %s: name %s, width %s, opens %s', async (testID, name, weight, href) => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  const segment = screen.getByRole('link', { name })
  expect(segment).toHaveProp('testID', testID)
  expect(segment).toHaveProp('href', href)
  expect(segment).toHaveStyle({ flexGrow: weight })
})

test('the bar has only four segments in order: Blocked 0 has no segment', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  expect(screen.getAllByRole('link').map((link) => link.props.testID)).toEqual(
    SEGMENTS.map(([testID]) => testID)
  )
  expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-blocked')).toBeNull()
})

test('the legend has all five lines, Blocked 0 included, in gray text of size caption', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  for (const text of LEGEND) {
    expect(screen.getByText(text)).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.muted, fontSize: tokens.fsCaption })
  }
})

test('Showroom: the bar has only the In Progress and Not Started segments, the legend still has all five lines', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf(showroom)} />)

  expect(screen.getAllByRole('link').map((link) => link.props.testID)).toEqual([
    'status-inProgress',
    'status-notStarted'
  ])
  expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'In Progress 1' })).toHaveProp(
    'testID',
    'status-inProgress'
  )
  expect(screen.getByTestId('status-notStarted')).toHaveStyle({ flexGrow: 5 })
  for (const text of ['Done 0', 'In Progress 1', 'Waiting 0', 'Blocked 0', 'Not Started 5']) {
    expect(screen.getByText(text)).toBeOnTheScreen()
  }
})

// The Views of the table have a role but no accessible (accessible on a container makes VoiceOver skip
// the child elements), so getByRole of RNTL does not see them: walk the tree and read the role prop.
const elementsOf = (node: TestInstance) =>
  node.children.filter((child) => typeof child !== 'string')
const rolesOf = (parent: TestInstance) => elementsOf(parent).map((child) => child.props.role)

test('pressing Table view: the button is pressed, a table of five data rows shows, the bar and legend are gone', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view'))

  expect(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', true)
  const table = screen.getByTestId('status-table')
  expect(table).toHaveProp('role', 'table')
  expect(table).toHaveStyle({ gap: tokens.space8 })
  // One header row, then five data rows.
  expect(rolesOf(table)).toEqual(['row', 'row', 'row', 'row', 'row', 'row'])
  expect(table.parent).toHaveStyle({ gap: tokens.space8 })
  expect(elementsOf(table.parent!)).toEqual([table])
  expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-done')).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.queryByRole('link')).toBeNull()
  for (const text of LEGEND) expect(screen.queryByText(text)).toBeNull()
})

test('table: the first row has two column headers Status and Work items, the later rows have only data cells', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view'))

  const [head, ...rows] = elementsOf(screen.getByTestId('status-table'))
  expect(rolesOf(head!)).toEqual(['columnheader', 'columnheader'])
  expect(within(head!).getByText('Status')).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall })
  expect(within(head!).getByText('Work items')).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall })
  for (const row of rows) expect(rolesOf(row)).toEqual(['cell', 'cell'])
})

test('pressing Table view again: the button is released and the chart comes back', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view'))
  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view'))

  expect(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view')).toHaveProp('aria-pressed', false)
  expect(screen.queryByTestId('status-table')).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.getByTestId('status-done')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  expect(screen.getByText('Blocked 0')).toBeOnTheScreen()
})

test('each table row is a name then a number, small text, two cells sharing the row evenly', async () => {
  await render(<StatusCard status={statusOf()} />)

  await fireEvent.press(screen.getByTestId('status-table-view'))

  const rows = elementsOf(screen.getByTestId('status-table')).slice(1)
  expect(rows).toHaveLength(TABLE.length)
  TABLE.forEach(([name, count], index) => {
    const row = rows[index]!
    expect(row).toHaveStyle({ flexDirection: 'row', gap: tokens.space10 })
    const [nameCell, countCell] = elementsOf(row)
    expect(nameCell).toHaveStyle({ flex: 1 })
    expect(countCell).toHaveStyle({ flex: 1 })
    expect(within(nameCell!).getByText(name)).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall })
    expect(within(countCell!).getByText(count)).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall })
  })
})
```

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Banner } from '../../../design-system/Banner'
import { Card } from '../../../design-system/Card'
import { Glyph } from '../../../design-system/Glyph'
import { Text } from '../../../design-system/Text'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './HealthCard.styles'

type Health = ReturnType<typeof buildOverview>['health']

// Symbol and color of the health level (wireframe.css:117): shape and text, never color alone.
const RAG = {
  green: { glyph: 'ragGreen', tone: 'good' },
  amber: { glyph: 'ragAmber', tone: 'waiting' },
  red: { glyph: 'ragRed', tone: 'critical' },
  unknown: { glyph: 'ragUnknown', tone: 'muted' }
} as const

// One row of the card: the label ("Declared by PM", "Computed") and the level.
function Level({ line }: { line: Health['computed'] }) {
  const rag = RAG[line.level]
  return (
    <View style={styles.line}>
      <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
        {line.label}
      </Text>
      <View style={styles.level}>
        <Glyph name={rag.glyph} size="badge" tone={rag.tone} label={line.text} />
        <Text variant="small" weight="500">
          {line.text}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  )
}

// Declared health and computed health (html:51-58, OVW-05). Banner takes only text, so the testID goes on the frame
// that wraps it.
export function HealthCard({ health }: { health: Health }) {
  return (
    <Card title={health.title}>
      <View style={styles.body}>
        <Level line={health.declared} />
        <Level line={health.computed} />
        {health.warning === null ? null : (
          <View testID="health-warning">
            <Banner text={health.warning} />
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
    </Card>
  )
}
```

```ts
  // Level (css:115): the symbol is 5 away from the text.
```

```tsx
import { render, screen, within } from '@testing-library/react-native'

import type { Overview } from '../../../core/api/overview'
import { tokens } from '../../../design-system/tokens'
import { meridian } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { showroom } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/showroom'
import { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { STRINGS } from '../strings'
import { HealthCard } from './HealthCard'

// The warning sentence of Meridian (OVW-05), exactly as in wireframe html:56.
const WARNING =
  'Declared health is better than computed. Delivery: 9 overdue items including 3 milestones. Risk: 1 critical risk without mitigation.'

// Build the model inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs when the file loads is a static mutant of Stryker).
const healthOf = (data: Overview = meridian) =>
  buildOverview(data, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    scope: 'project'
  }).health

// The four levels (wireframe.css:117): its symbol and color.
const LEVELS = [
  ['green', '●', tokens.good],
  ['amber', '▲', tokens.waiting],
  ['red', '■', tokens.critical],
  ['unknown', '?', tokens.muted]
] as const

test('Health card of Meridian: level 3 title, two rows of label and level, then the warning strip, in a space8 column', async () => {
  await render(<HealthCard health={healthOf()} />)

  expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Health' })).toHaveProp('aria-level', 3)
  const declared = screen.getByText('Declared by PM')
  const computed = screen.getByText('Computed')
  expect(declared).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall, color: tokens.muted })
  expect(computed).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall, color: tokens.muted })
  const column = declared.parent?.parent
  expect(column).toHaveStyle({ gap: tokens.space8 })
  expect(column?.children).toEqual([
    declared.parent,
    computed.parent,
    screen.getByTestId('health-warning')
  ])
  // Each row: the label on the left, the level on the right.
  for (const label of [declared, computed]) {
    expect(label.parent).toHaveStyle({
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      justifyContent: 'space-between'
    })
    expect(label.parent?.children[0]).toBe(label)
  }
})

test('declared level At risk and computed level Off track: the symbol has the name and color of the level, the text is size small in medium weight', async () => {
  await render(<HealthCard health={healthOf()} />)

  const atRisk = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'At risk' })
  expect(atRisk).toHaveTextContent('▲')
  expect(atRisk).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.waiting, fontSize: tokens.fsBadge })
  const offTrack = screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Off track' })
  expect(offTrack).toHaveTextContent('■')
  expect(offTrack).toHaveStyle({ color: tokens.critical, fontSize: tokens.fsBadge })
  for (const [mark, text] of [
    [atRisk, 'At risk'],
    [offTrack, 'Off track']
  ] as const) {
    const level = screen.getByText(text)
    expect(level).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsSmall, fontWeight: '500', color: tokens.text })
    expect(level.parent).toHaveStyle({
      flexDirection: 'row',
      alignItems: 'center',
      gap: tokens.space5
    })
    expect(level.parent?.children).toEqual([mark, level])
  }
})

test('warning strip: the frame with testID health-warning wraps Banner, the text is exactly the sentence of the model', async () => {
  await render(<HealthCard health={healthOf()} />)

  const warning = screen.getByTestId('health-warning')
  const sentence = within(warning).getByText(WARNING)
  expect(sentence).toHaveStyle({ fontSize: tokens.fsCrumbs, color: tokens.text })
  expect(sentence.parent).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: tokens.waitingBg })
  expect(warning.children).toEqual([sentence.parent])
})

test.each(LEVELS)(
  'level %s: symbol %s color %s, the name of the level is read to the screen reader',
  async (level, mark, color) => {
    await render(
      <HealthCard
        health={{
          ...healthOf(),
          warning: null,
          computed: { label: 'Computed', level, text: `Level ${level}` }
        }}
      />
    )

    const glyph = screen.getByRole('img', { name: `Level ${level}` })
    expect(glyph).toHaveTextContent(mark)
    expect(glyph).toHaveStyle({ color })
  }
)

test('Showroom: declared On track, computed Unknown, cannot be compared so there is no warning strip', async () => {
  await render(<HealthCard health={healthOf(showroom)} />)

  expect(screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'On track' })).toHaveTextContent('●')
  expect(screen.getByRole('img', { name: 'Unknown' })).toHaveTextContent('?')
  expect(screen.queryByTestId('health-warning')).toBeNull()
  expect(screen.getByText('Computed').parent?.parent?.children).toHaveLength(2)
})
```

```tsx
}
```

```tsx
import { meridian } from '../../../mocks/fixtures/meridian'
import { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { STRINGS } from '../strings'
import { CategoryCard } from './CategoryCard'

const WBS = '/w/creative-studio/projects/meridian-cgi-campaign/wbs'

// Build the model inside each test, not at the top of the file (code that runs while the file loads is a Stryker static mutant).
const modelOf = () =>
  buildOverview(meridian, {
    locale: 'en',
    strings: STRINGS.en,
    workspaceId: 'creative-studio',
    projectId: 'meridian-cgi-campaign',
    scope: 'project'
  })

// The six rows of Meridian (html:65-70): name, value, the path it opens, and the segments of the bar (done is filled green,
// the rest is filled gray; segment 0 was dropped by the model, D-B14): relative width and fill color.
const ROWS = [
  ['Deliverables', '0 / 5', `${WBS}?category=1.0`, [[5, tokens.neutralFill]]],
  ['Technical', '2 / 2', `${WBS}?category=2.0`, [[2, tokens.good]]],
  ['Quality', '0 / 2', `${WBS}?category=3.0`, [[2, tokens.neutralFill]]],
  ['Timeline', '0 / 1', `${WBS}?category=4.0`, [[1, tokens.neutralFill]]],
  ['Resource', '1 / 1', `${WBS}?category=5.0`, [[1, tokens.good]]],
  ['Risk', '0 / 1', `${WBS}?category=6.0`, [[1, tokens.neutralFill]]]
] as const

const elementsOf = (node: TestInstance) =>
  node.children.filter((child) => typeof child !== 'string')
// A row holds the label, the bar frame, then the value; the bar frame holds BarTrack, and BarTrack holds the segments.
const partsOf = (row: TestInstance) => elementsOf(elementsOf(elementsOf(row)[1]!)[0]!)

test('Progress by category card: level 3 heading, gray caption at the top of the card, six rows in the space8 column', async () => {
  const model = modelOf()
  await render(<CategoryCard rows={model.categories} titles={model.titles} />)

  expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Progress by category' })).toHaveProp('aria-level', 3)
  expect(screen.getByText('done / work items')).toHaveStyle({
    fontSize: tokens.fsSmall,
    color: tokens.muted
  })
  const column = screen.getByTestId('category-0').parent
  expect(column).toHaveStyle({ gap: tokens.space8 })
  expect(elementsOf(column!).map((row) => row.props.testID)).toEqual(
    ROWS.map((_, index) => `category-${index}`)
  )
})

test.each(ROWS.map((row, index) => [index, ...row] as const))(
  'row category-%s %s: value %s, opens %s, the segments of the bar',
  async (index, name, value, href, segments) => {
    const model = modelOf()
    await render(<CategoryCard rows={model.categories} titles={model.titles} />)

    const row = screen.getByTestId(`category-${index}`)
    expect(row).toHaveProp('role', 'link')
    expect(row).toHaveProp('href', href)
    expect(within(row).getByText(name)).toHaveStyle({
      fontSize: tokens.fsSmall,
      color: tokens.text
    })
    expect(within(row).getByText(value)).toBeOnTheScreen()
    const parts = partsOf(row)
    expect(parts).toHaveLength(segments.length)
    segments.forEach(([weight, color], at) => {
      expect(parts[at]).toHaveStyle({ flexGrow: weight, backgroundColor: color })
    })
  }
)

test('Category with both a done part and a remaining part: two segments in the order done then remaining', async () => {
  const model = modelOf()
  await render(
    <CategoryCard
      rows={[
        {
          ...model.categories[0]!,
          name: 'Mixed',
          value: '1 / 4',
          segments: [
            { tone: 'good', weight: 1 },
            { tone: 'neutral', weight: 3 }
          ]
        }
      ]}
      titles={model.titles}
    />
  )

  const parts = partsOf(screen.getByTestId('category-0'))
  expect(parts).toHaveLength(2)
  expect(parts[0]).toHaveStyle({ flexGrow: 1, backgroundColor: tokens.good })
  expect(parts[1]).toHaveStyle({ flexGrow: 3, backgroundColor: tokens.neutralFill })
  expect(screen.getByText('Mixed')).toBeOnTheScreen()
  expect(screen.getByText('1 / 4')).toBeOnTheScreen()
})
```

```tsx
import { View } from 'react-native'

import { Avatar } from '../../../design-system/Avatar'
import { BarRow } from '../../../design-system/BarRow'
import { Card } from '../../../design-system/Card'
import { ShareBar } from '../../../design-system/ShareBar'
import { Text } from '../../../design-system/Text'
import type { buildOverview } from '../model'
import { styles } from './WorkloadCard.styles'

type Model = ReturnType<typeof buildOverview>

// Workload by person in charge (html:73-81): each row is a link that drills down to the WBS of that person.
export function WorkloadCard({
  rows,
  titles
}: {
  rows: Model['workload']
  titles: Model['titles']
}) {
  return (
    <Card
      title={titles.workload.title}
      aside={
        <Text variant="small" tone="muted">
          {titles.workload.caption}
        </Text>
      }
    >
      <View style={styles.body}>
        {rows.map((row, index) => (
          <BarRow
            key={index}
            label={
              <View style={styles.person}>
                <Avatar size="sm" initials={row.initials} name={row.name} />
                <Text variant="small">{row.name}</Text>
              </View>
            }
            value={row.value}
            href={row.route}
            testID={`workload-${index}`}
          >
            <ShareBar share={row.share} />
          </BarRow>
        ))}
      </View>
    </Card>
  )
}
```
